note: Greater Bay map frame (gbareal). Local metres around each anchor: +x east, +z south (three.js local axes before rotation). Real OSM data of this build; heights are OSM values where height / levels are mapped (levels x 3.1 m + 1 m), otherwise estimated from similar buildings (right class, not the right building; Shenzhen has levels on ~19 % of its footprints, Dongguan ~3 %). parts = OSM building:part pieces with base / top heights. terrain = ground heights (m) on a grid around the anchor (rows north to south; the bare-earth estimate). roads: cls 0-1 freeway, 2-9 arterials, 10 local, 11 service, 12 path, 13 runway, 14 taxiway, 15 rail, 16 people mover, 17 pier; elev = deck height above the ground per vertex for bridges / flyovers. ground = terrain height (m) at the anchor. sel = what was listed: the box, or for big sites only what lies within 200 m of the target's own OSM area.
